Kawara Shrine can refer to two shrines in [[Ise Grand Shrine]]
*[[Kawara Shrine (Naikū)]] (川原神社)
*[[Kawara Shrine (Gekū)]] (河原神社)
**its sessha [[Kawarabuchi Shrine]]
There is also the similarly names

[[Kawarabuchi Shrine]] located near [[Kawara Shrine (Gekū)]]

== Other shrines (川原神社) ==

* [[Kawahara Shrine]]   has the same spelling as [[Kawara Shrine (Naikū)]]

== Kawara Shrines (河原神社) ==
'''Kawara Shrine''' (河原神社) refers to several Shinto shrines located throughout Japan.
* [[User:Immanuelle/Kawara Shrine (Gyōda)|Kawara Shrine (Gyōda)]] - Located in [[Gyōda]], [[Saitama Prefecture]].
* [[User:Immanuelle/Kawara Shrine (Wakasa)|Kawara Shrine (Wakasa)]] - Located in [[Wakasa, Fukui|Wakasa]], [[Fukui Prefecture]].
* [[User:Immanuelle/Kawara Shrine (Okazaki)]] - Located in [[Okazaki, Aichi|Okazaki]], [[Aichi Prefecture]].
* [[Kawara Shrine (Kiyosu)]] - Located in [[Kiyosu]], Aichi Prefecture.
* [[Kawara Shrine (Gekū)]] - Located in [[Ise, Mie|Ise]], [[Mie Prefecture]], an auxiliary shrine of [[Toyōke Daijingū]].
* [[User:Immanuelle/Kawara Shrine (Maizuru)|Kawara Shrine (Maizuru)]] - Located in [[Maizuru]], [[Kyoto Prefecture]].
* [[User:Immanuelle/Kawara Shrine (Matsue)|Kawara Shrine (Matsue)]] - Located in [[Matsue]], [[Shimane Prefecture]].
